aspects.says: Only an acquire that succeeds gets the edge: an await that returned false, a get that timed out or returned null, or a poll that returned null orders nothing.
basis: section:Only an Acquire That Succeeds, on the Same Object, Gets the Edge

aspects.says: A java.util.concurrent hand-off (submit to task, task to Future.get, countDown to await, put to take, map put to get) is a happens-before edge, so data passed through it needs no volatile fields or locks of its own.
basis: section:A java.util.concurrent Hand-off Is a Happens-before Edge, and It Carries Plain Data

aspects.says: Each java.util.concurrent class states its edges in a 'Memory consistency effects' paragraph of its javadoc.
aspects.reason: the exact javadoc wording is lookup material; the practices and the quiz check the edges it states, not the sentences

aspects.says: A value changed in place after it was put in a ConcurrentHashMap may be seen changed, partly changed or unchanged by a thread that gets it.
basis: section:The Edge Covers Writes Made Before the Release, Not After It

aspects.says: A println in a spin loop takes a lock the writer never takes, so it can make a visibility bug disappear on HotSpot without creating an edge.
basis: section:Sleep, Yield and println Create No Edge, Even When the Loop Ends

aspects.says: The edge covers writes made before the release; data changed after a put, a countDown or a submit is shared with no edge, so the producer must not touch it again.
basis: section:The Edge Covers Writes Made Before the Release, Not After It

aspects.says: An unlock is ordered only before later locks of the same monitor; a lock the writer never takes gives the reader no edge, and HotSpot may remove a lock on an unshared object altogether.
basis: section:Only an Acquire That Succeeds, on the Same Object, Gets the Edge

aspects.says: Thread.sleep and Thread.yield have no synchronization semantics, and a delay orders neither memory nor time; wait on a Future or a latch instead.
basis: section:Sleep, Yield and println Create No Edge, Even When the Loop Ends
